title: Shaded Regions Lab
prompt: Choose a figure, predict the shaded area, reveal the subtraction steps, and complete quick checks.

fallback.markdown: The Shaded Regions Lab helps you identify the whole area, find the circular area removed, subtract, and check the units. If the mini-app is unavailable, use the worked examples in the lesson and practice the same four-step routine: whole area, removed area, subtraction, square units.
